topGaps.title: nasr-m2o CPU runaway — 260%
topGaps.description: nasr-m2o container pegged at 260% CPU (3.9 GiB / 8 GiB RAM). Likely infinite loop or stuck LLM request. Needs restart/investigation.

topGaps.title: Container sprawl — 10+ unhealthy services
topGaps.description: Claude proxy, claude-worker, joinly, qwen3-tts, chatterbox-tts, vllm-docker, muninndb-pilot, spacetimedb, Pinokio, Home Assistant — all exited:unhealthy. Dead weight consuming Coolify slots.

topGaps.title: Memgraph hitting 1 GiB memory limit (65%)
topGaps.description: memory-memgraph container using 665 MiB / 1 GiB limit. Will OOM as the knowledge graph grows. Limit needs bumping to 2-4 GiB.

topGaps.title: memory-embeddings at 14.18 GiB RAM
topGaps.description: BGE embeddings model using 14.18 GiB (11.3% of host). Largest single allocation. Consider quantised model or dedicated GPU inference.

topGaps.title: vLLM local inference unstable
topGaps.description: Qwen3-14B-AWQ was added then reverted this week. Local LLM inference for memory/reasoning pipeline not yet stable.

topGaps.title: No org-level shared memory namespace
topGaps.description: Agents are siloed — each has private memory. Shared Qdrant org_memory namespace not yet deployed despite Memgraph being available.
